data.title: W / 维什戴尔 · 唱片封面的选择
data.description: 她在唱片架前停下，抽出一张封面格外夸张的唱片，翻过来看曲目，问你敢不敢盲买。
data.action: 从唱片架中抽出一张唱片
data.camera: 中景，唱片架延伸至背景
data.promptProse: Browsing through wooden bins in a vintage vinyl record shop, W slides out a bold, colorful album sleeve, inspecting the psychedelic tracklist under warm Edison bulbs. Rows of vinyl records, retro band posters plastered on brick walls, and turntable display listening stations craft a cozy, counter-culture sanctuary around her.
